MoE Exit Exam (HEEE):

• Pass mark: 50%
• Format: 100 MCQs, 3 hours
• For your program blueprint, contact your department head.

Grading at MAU:

• Continuous Assessment: 50%
• Midterm: 20%
• Final: 30%

Honors: Distinction 3.00–3.49 | Great 3.50–3.74 | Very Great ≥ 3.75

Course Registration:

1. Log in to dashboard.
2. Click "Browse & Register".
3. Search the course.
4. Click "Enroll".
5. Confirm.

Digital Clearance:

Library → Department Head → Dorm Proctor → Registrar & Finance.
Then Exit Certificate with QR code.

Finance & Tuition:

Methods: Telebirr, CBE Birr, Awash Bank, Bank Transfer.
View balance under "Finance & Tuition".
